flashpoints.escalation_markers: Rates above expectations, retaliation, or extension to critical minerals and energy.

headlines.summary: Video shows containers and debris scattered around the Strait of Hormuz due to the recent attacks on vessels.

headlines.title: Oil falls as investors assess Mideast tensions, International Energy Agency's report
headlines.summary: Oil fell Thursday, as traders assessed attacks on ships passing through Hormuz, while digesting the International Energy Agency's latest monthly report.

headlines.title: Container ship sinks in Strait of Hormuz as Iran steps up attacks
headlines.summary: Iran has escalated its strikes on commercial ships transiting Hormuz in recent weeks, as it tries to choke off a rebound in crude oil exports.

headlines.title: Iran says it’s ‘counting the moments’ until it can strike U.S. warships; Saudi Aramco facilities attacked
headlines.summary: Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia's Aramco reportedly came under fresh attack overnight.

headlines.title: Centcom Forces Disable Cargo Vessel Attempting to Violate Blockade
headlines.summary: Service members operating in the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility recently disabled a commercial cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman, after the ship's crew ignored repeated warnings and attempted to run the ongoing naval blockade against Iran.

headlines.title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
headlines.summary: Four years after the attacks, Serhii Kuznetsov appears in court accused of a plot to destroy Russia's gas pipelines to Germany.

headlines.title: Russian nuclear-powered submarine fires missiles during Pacific drills
headlines.summary: Russia's Pacific Fleet has test-fired cruise missiles from a nuclear-powered submarine, striking a target 1,200km away.

headlines.title: Ukraine: Residents killed and dozens injured in attacks on Kharkiv and Kyiv
headlines.summary: Russian attacks in recent days on on Ukraine’s two largest cities have again killed and injured civilians, damaged homes and civilian infrastructure, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) said on Tuesday.

headlines.title: World News in Brief: Gaza braces for winter amid attacks, joint patrols in CAR, 90 cities commit to sustainable development
headlines.summary: The UN and its partners are stepping up preparations in Gaza for the approaching cold and rainy season, even as attacks affecting civilians continue, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) said on Wednesday.

headlines.title: Container ship hit by projectile sinks in Strait of Hormuz, Singapore says
headlines.summary: All 21 sailors on the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride were evacuated safely after it was hit by an projectile on Tuesday, maritime authorities say.

headlines.title: North Korea tests two submarine-launched missiles, state media reports
headlines.summary: The tests showcase North Korea's war deterrent capabilities in the region, KCNA says.

headlines.title: Yemen: Houthi siege, cholera outbreak and aid cuts put civilians in the crosshairs
headlines.summary: Yemen’s southwestern city of Taiz is facing a “devastating” humanitarian crisis as escalating tensions are dramatically driving up food prices and causing shortages of supplies, the UN Spokesperson said on Tuesday.

geo.caveat: Each flashpoint is measured against its own trailing 30-day median, so a long-running conflict does not sit at maximum forever. This measures how loud a story is relative to its own normal - not what will happen.

profile.name: FOMC Member Speaks
profile.what: Remarks from a regional Fed president or governor.
profile.why_gold: Mostly background, but a known hawk turning dovish - or the reverse - is a genuine signal, and voting members matter more than non-voters.
profile.watch: Whether the speaker votes this year, and whether they are departing from their usual stance.
profile.gotchas: Several speakers a day is normal and almost always noise. Treat as background unless the tone genuinely shifts.

profile.name: Producer Price Index
profile.what: Inflation at the wholesale level, released 13:30 UK.
profile.why_gold: A leading indicator for consumer inflation, and several PPI components feed straight into the PCE calculation, so analysts revise their PCE estimates within minutes of it.
profile.watch: The health-care and portfolio-management components, because those are the ones that map into core PCE.
profile.gotchas: Usually a minor event unless it lands the day before or after CPI.

profile.name: Retail Sales
profile.what: Monthly change in receipts at retail stores. Released 13:30 UK.
profile.why_gold: The cleanest read on whether the consumer - roughly 70% of the US economy - is still spending. Feeds growth expectations and therefore the rate path.
profile.watch: The control group, which strips autos, petrol, building materials and food services. That is the number that feeds GDP.
profile.gotchas: Not adjusted for inflation, so a hot print during high inflation can mean less than it looks.

profile.name: Initial Jobless Claims
profile.what: New unemployment benefit filings in the prior week. Released every Thursday at 13:30 UK.
profile.why_gold: The highest-frequency labour signal available. Individually minor, but a trend of rising claims shifts the whole rate narrative.
profile.watch: The four-week moving average rather than the weekly print, and continuing claims for whether people are finding new work.
profile.gotchas: Distorted by holidays, weather and state-level administrative quirks. One bad week means nothing.
